title: Grade_4_CRE_Prog_13_Trusting_in_God
subject: cre
text:
2 ” to allow audio playback #music# Hello learner, welcome to grade four Christian Religious Education programme. Today we are going to learn about Trusting in God. The radio teacher is Purity Mukuhi , welcome to the programme. #music#

3 ” to allow audio playback Hello grade 4 learner today we shall talk about trusting in God. Today we shall talk about trusting in God. Before we start our lesson. What did we learn about people you can trust at home and at school? #b ell # Learner, have you remembered about people you can trust at home and at school? # bell # This is what you learnt; One: We should talk to our parents and guardians about the people we should trust. T w o: Sometimes the people we trust can harm us. Three: When harmed by anybody we should report other people we trust. Four: We should not trust strangers and that we should say No to strangers who give us things or ask us to go somewhere with them. # music # Today we are going to learn about trusting in God. Why should we trust in God? # bell # To trust in God is to completely depend in God in all we do. God is the creator and controller of everything. God controls all situations in life. We should pray that God helps us always no matter the situations we are in at any given moment. We must trust in God whether we are sad or happy. # music # Learner when we trust in God he protects us from evil, trusting in God also gives us strength to say “No” to things that can harm us. Learner, do you have a Bible next to you? I will give you time to open Psalms 125: 1. Psalms chapter 125: 1. # music # Learner welcome back. Did you open psalms chapter 125: 1? Good, let’s now read. Those who trust in the lord are like Mount Zion, which can never be shaken, never be moved. Those who trust in the lord are like Mount Zion, which can never be shaken, never be moved. # music # When we read Psalms chapter 125: 1 we learn that those who trust in the Lord are like Mount Zion, the mountain can never be shaken, the mountain can never be moved. I hope u have already read psalms chapter 125: 1. Learner those who trust in God are compared to? #b ell #

4 ” to allow audio playback Learner did you say Mount Zion? #b ell # Good, what cannot happen to Mount Zion? #b ell # I hope you said that it will never be shaken or moved, we must trust in God always in all that we do in our lives as Christians. He is our creator and giver of all we need. Before we end the lesson, what have we learnt? #b ell # Today, we have learnt that; One: When we trust in God, He protects us from evil. T w o: Trusting in God gives us strength to say ‘No’ to people and things that can harm us. Three: God promises to protect us and keep us safe if we put our trust in him. Four: When we trust in God we are not afraid. Five: Trust in God makes us remain strong whenever we are faced with challenges. Six: We trust in God when we tell him everything that affects us through prayer. Seven: God is faithful to us and is patient with us. #m usic # Now let’s open Psalms chapter 125: 1 and recite it; “Those who trust in the Lord are like Mount Zion, which can never be shaken, never be moved. ” #m usic # Welcome back. I hope you have enjoyed the lesson. Today we were talking about trusting in God. Learner, think of all good things God has done in your life. Write a poem about His goodness and recite it to your parents or guardians and your siblings at home. We have now come to the end of our lesson today. #m usic #

5 ” to allow audio playback That was Christian Religious Education for grade 4. The presenter was Purity Mukuhi. Goodbye. #music#
